title: CASCADE: An Agentic Regulatory Network Framework for Patient-Data-Validated Downstream Perturbation Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2608.05359v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: CASCADE is an agentic framework that predicts downstream transcriptional effects of gene perturbation from precomputed   ARACNe regulatory networks, exposed via MCP. Prior work validates such tools by checking whether predicted genes are   known cancer genes (membership); we instead test whether the predicted direction of change matches reality, using   focal-gene copy-number amplification as a dosage-based proxy for the inverse of knockdown against real TCGA patient   tumor data.   For MYC, CASCADE's predicted knockdown targets show strong concordance with real amplified-vs-non-amplified tumor   expression across three cancer types (BRCA: 90.0%, COAD: 72.0%, STAD: 85.7%; all p<0.0013), well above permutation   baselines, surviving a PAM50 subtype control and replicating in an independent cohort (METABRIC, 87.2%). translated_title: CASCADE：一个基于智能体调控网络框架的患者数据验证的下游扰动预测
translated_abstract: CASCADE是一个智能体框架，它从预计算的ARACNe调控网络预测基因扰动的下游转录效应，并通过MCP协议进行暴露。先前的工作通过检查预测的基因是否为已知癌症基因（成员关系）来验证此类工具；我们则测试预测的变化方向是否与现实相符，使用局灶基因拷贝数扩增作为敲低反向效应的基于剂量的代理指标，并与真实的TCGA患者肿瘤数据进行对比验证。对于MYC，CASCADE预测的敲低靶点在三种癌症类型中与真实的扩增vs非扩增肿瘤表达显示出强烈的一致性（BRCA：90.0%，COAD：72.0%，STAD：85.7%；所有p<0.0013），远高于置换基线，通过了PAM50亚型对照检验，并在独立队列（METABRIC，87.2%）中得到复现。与通过Fisher精确检验的经人工整理的MSigDB基因集基线相比，CASCADE的准确性并未显示超出
tldr: CASCADE是一个通过MCP暴露的智能体调控网络框架，创新性地使用真实TCGA患者肿瘤数据（以局灶基因拷贝数扩增作为敲低的剂量代理）验证基因扰动预测的“方向准确性”而非“成员关系”，在MYC靶点预测中于三种癌症类型达到72%-90%的准确率，并在独立队列METABRIC中得到复现。
en_tdlr: CASCADE is an agentic regulatory network framework exposed via MCP that innovatively validates gene perturbation predictions using "directional accuracy" against real TCGA patient tumor data—with focal-gene copy-number amplification as a dosage-based proxy for knockdown—achieving 72%-90% concordance for MYC knockdown targets across three cancer types and replicating in the independent METABRIC cohort.
